For Elasticsearch 2.3, OpenSearch Service supports the following operations.
• All operations in the index path (such as
/index-name /_forcemerge  and
/index-name /_recovery ) except
/index-name /_close

• /_aliases
• /_all
• /_analyze
• /_bulk
• /_cache/clear  (index only)
